Bihar only. 1-based page of the source PDF named in source_file. Needed for the consolidated volumes of 2017-18 to 2020-21 (about 2,100 pages each).
1-based row position in the year table BR_<yy>_complete.csv. The row address used in NDJSON _ids.

object_head for the detail table (Karnataka's object_head columns). object_head_summary for rows on the pages of a demand's object-head summary annex, which repeats the whole demand; those rows are never leaves.
Hierarchy level. Voted and Charged are the major-head Voted/Charged lines.
2-digit object head code: the additive leaf level (Tamil Nadu calls it the sub-detailed head).
Account code as printed, where extracted.
V = Voted, C = Charged, blank = not marked.

The four positional amounts, in rupees. <type> is accounts (position 1, document year - 2), budget_estimate (position 2, year - 1, and position 4, the document year) or revised_estimate (position 3, year - 1). <year> is the fiscal year with an underscore, e.g. budget_estimate_2024_25_amount_inRs. Blank when the cell is blank, a dash or unreadable.
Unit of the amounts: rupees. Divide by 1e7 for crore.
Package-relative path of the source PDF. Blank in a build without PDFs.
